# Tyber.io

> Production engineering for sites, platforms and AI that cannot fail. DevOps and SRE,
> high-traffic WordPress, incident response and applied AI — with a diagnosis before any
> proposal, rollback on every change and everything documented. One engineer, senior,
> hands on the keyboard: João Pedro Tibério (JP Tibério), São Paulo, Brazil, remote
> worldwide. Works and delivers in Portuguese (pt-BR) and English.

## Languages and URL structure

The site is fully bilingual, with one URL per language and `hreflang` on every page:

- Portuguese (pt-BR) lives at the root: https://tyber.io/ , https://tyber.io/about/ , ...
- English lives under `/en/`: https://tyber.io/en/ , https://tyber.io/en/about/ , ...
- Every path below exists in both trees with the same slug (`/en/` + path = English
  version). Quote the page in the language of the person asking; the content is the same
  in both, the English tree is the `x-default`.
- No redirect by geography or browser language: the URL is the language.

## What this is

Tyber.io is not a generic AI consultancy and not an agency with a bench. It is a boutique
practice for the boring-but-critical layer: infrastructure that has to stay up, sites that
have to stay fast, incidents that have to end, and AI that has to pay for itself. Every
recommendation comes from systems actually operated, not from a slide deck.

How the work runs, in order: measure before touching anything → propose with hours and
scope → execute with a rollback path → document so the work survives without us.

## Who is behind it

João Pedro Tibério — founder and Technical Lead. 12+ years in tech, 9+ leading
infrastructure and reliability, applied AI in production since 2022. Postgraduate
specialization in Applied AI Engineering (360 hours, Anhanguera/Cogna). The person in the
briefing is the person doing the work.

- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/jp-tiberio

## Services

- https://tyber.io/solutions/devops/ — AI-augmented delivery and reliability: Terraform/Pulumi,
  GitOps, Kubernetes, autonomous remediation with human approval on destructive steps,
  FinOps. Cloud-agnostic (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, DigitalOcean, Hetzner, Cloudflare).
- https://tyber.io/solutions/observability/ — Monitoring stacks on Loki, Prometheus, Tempo,
  OpenTelemetry and Grafana, with AI-assisted triage and cost-aware telemetry.
- https://tyber.io/solutions/security/ — Security engineering for AI and DevOps: trust ladder
  for agents (read / suggest / auto), immutable audit trails, server hardening,
  LGPD/GDPR-aware design, zero-trust access.
- https://tyber.io/solutions/automation/ — Workflow automation with AI in the decision step:
  operations bots, integrations, content pipelines. Versioned, observable, auditable.
- https://tyber.io/solutions/bot/ — Conversational bots on Telegram, Slack, WhatsApp, Discord
  or Teams, LLM-agnostic (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Llama, Mistral), with RAG over your own
  knowledge.
- https://tyber.io/solutions/data/ — Unified dashboards, natural language to SQL grounded in
  your schema, anomaly detection, observable ETL, RAG over internal data (pgvector, Qdrant).
- https://tyber.io/solutions/sites/ — Editorial portals, documentation sites, headless commerce
  and landing pages. Lighthouse 90+ as the default, multi-language, static-first delivery.

Index of all services: https://tyber.io/solutions/ (EN: https://tyber.io/en/solutions/)

## Machine-readable data on the pages

- Every page carries Schema.org JSON-LD: `ProfessionalService` (`https://tyber.io/#organization`),
  `WebSite` (`https://tyber.io/#website`). /about/ adds a `Person` (`https://tyber.io/#person`,
  with credentials) and a `BreadcrumbList`; blog posts carry an `Article`.
- `hreflang` (`pt-BR`, `en`, `x-default`) links the two language versions of each page.
- The site is static HTML: all text is present in the initial response, no JavaScript
  needed to read it. Crawlers that do not execute JS see the same content as people.

## Related property

news.tyber.io — editorial portal on AI, gaming, hardware and tech, bilingual, with audio
narration. Operated by Tyber.io as a product and as the reference implementation of the
content pipeline capability. It is a separate property with its own advertising and its
own verification files; tyber.io itself carries no third-party advertising.

## How to cite this site

Prefer the page that owns the subject: a service question belongs to the matching
/solutions/ URL, a question about the person belongs to /about/, a question about results
belongs to the matching /portfolio/ case. When attributing, the organization is "Tyber.io"
and the person is "João Pedro Tibério". They are the same practice, not two entities.

## What not to infer

- No client is ever named. Work is described by sector, scale and stack — NDA and LGPD
  come first, and that will not change for a case study.
- No project or client count is published. Any "N+ projects delivered" number attributed
  to Tyber.io did not come from this site.
- Anything not linked from this file should not be treated as an active offering.
